import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final long MOD = 1000000007;

    static class F {
        long v;

        F(long v) {
            this.v = v % MOD;
        }

        F add(F o) {
            return new F((this.v + o.v) % MOD);
        }

        F subtract(F o) {
            return new F((this.v - o.v + MOD) % MOD);
        }

        F multiply(F o) {
            return new F((this.v * o.v) % MOD);
        }

        F inv() {
            long a = v, b = MOD, u = 1, v2 = 0;
            while (b != 0) {
                long t = a / b;
                long tempA = a, tempB = b;
                a = tempB;
                b = tempA - t * tempB;
                long tempU = u, tempV2 = v2;
                u = tempV2;
                v2 = tempU - t * tempV2;
            }
            return new F(u);
        }

        F divide(F o) {
            return this.multiply(o.inv());
        }

        long get() {
            return v;
        }
    }

    static List<List<F>> matMul(List<List<F>> a, List<List<F>> b) {
        int n = a.size();
        int m = a.get(0).size();
        int p = b.get(0).size();
        List<List<F>> res = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            List<F> row = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int j = 0; j < p; j++) {
                row.add(new F(0));
            }
            res.add(row);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < p; j++) {
                for (int k = 0; k < m; k++) {
                    res.get(i).set(j, res.get(i).get(j).add(a.get(i).get(k).multiply(b.get(k).get(j))));
                }
            }
        }
        return res;
    }

    static List<F> matVec(List<List<F>> m, List<F> v) {
        int n = m.size();
        int m2 = v.size();
        List<F> res = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            F sum = new F(0);
            for (int j = 0; j < m2; j++) {
                sum = sum.add(m.get(i).get(j).multiply(v.get(j)));
            }
            res.add(sum);
        }
        return res;
    }

    static List<List<F>> make2D(int d1, int d2, F val) {
        List<List<F>> res = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < d1; i++) {
            List<F> row = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int j = 0; j < d2; j++) {
                row.add(new F(val.get()));
            }
            res.add(row);
        }
        return res;
    }

    static List<List<List<F>>> make3D(int d1, int d2, int d3, F val) {
        List<List<List<F>>> res = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < d1; i++) {
            List<List<F>> layer = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int j = 0; j < d2; j++) {
                List<F> row = new ArrayList<>();
                for (int k = 0; k < d3; k++) {
                    row.add(new F(val.get()));
                }
                layer.add(row);
            }
            res.add(layer);
        }
        return res;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        long n = sc.nextLong();
        int d = sc.nextInt();

        List<List<List<F>>> shifts = make3D(d, d + 1, d + 1, new F(0));
        for (int k = 0; k < d; k++) {
            for (int i = 0; i < d; i++) {
                shifts.get(k).get(i).set((i + k) % d, new F(1));
            }
            shifts.get(k).get(d).set(d, new F(1));
        }

        List<List<List<F>>> units = make3D(d, d + 1, d + 1, new F(0));
        for (int k = 0; k < d; k++) {
            for (int i = 0; i <= d; i++) {
                units.get(k).get(i).set(i, new F(1));
            }
            for (int i = 0; i <= d; i++) {
                units.get(k).get(k).set(i, new F(1));
            }
        }

        List<List<F>> identity = make2D(d + 1, d + 1, new F(0));
        for (int i = 0; i <= d; i++) {
            identity.get(i).set(i, new F(1));
        }

        Map<Long, List<List<F>>> cache = new HashMap<>();

        // Recursive function to get matrix
        class MatrixGetter {
            List<List<F>> getMatrix(long p) {
                if (cache.containsKey(p))
                    return cache.get(p);
                if (p <= d) {
                    List<List<F>> mat = make2D(d + 1, d + 1, new F(0));
                    for (int i = 0; i <= d; i++) {
                        mat.get(i).set(i, new F(1));
                    }
                    for (int k = 0; k < p; k++) {
                        mat = matMul(units.get(k), mat);
                    }
                    cache.put(p, mat);
                    return mat;
                }
                long child_p = d;
                while ((p + child_p - 1) / child_p > d) {
                    child_p *= d;
                }
                List<List<F>> child = getMatrix(child_p);
                List<List<F>> mat = child;
                long rem = p - child_p;
                for (int k = 1; k < d; k++) {
                    if (rem >= child_p) {
                        mat = matMul(shifts.get(d - k), mat);
                        mat = matMul(mat, shifts.get(k));
                        mat = matMul(mat, child);
                        rem -= child_p;
                    } else if (rem > 0) {
                        List<List<F>> remMat = getMatrix(rem);
                        mat = matMul(shifts.get(d - k), mat);
                        mat = matMul(mat, remMat);
                        mat = matMul(mat, shifts.get(k));
                        rem = 0;
                    } else {
                        break;
                    }
                }
                cache.put(p, mat);
                return mat;
            }
        }

        MatrixGetter getter = new MatrixGetter();
        List<List<F>> matrix = getter.getMatrix(n);
        List<F> baseVec = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i <= d; i++) {
            baseVec.add(new F(0));
        }
        baseVec.set(d, new F(1));
        List<F> finalVec = matVec(matrix, baseVec);
        F ans = new F(0);
        for (F v : finalVec) {
            ans = ans.add(v);
        }
        System.out.println(ans.get());
        sc.close();
    }
}
